ValidationRule.description: Consent evidence (what was agreed, when, how, by whom, signature) cannot be changed after the record is created. Withdraw the consent and capture a new one instead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Captured_At__c), ISCHANGED(Consent_Text__c), ISCHANGED(Consent_Text_Version__c), ISCHANGED(Opt_In_Method__c), ISCHANGED(Signature_Captured__c), ISCHANGED(Signature_Hash__c), ISCHANGED(Evidence_Hash__c), ISCHANGED(Captured_By__c), ISCHANGED(Capture_Device__c), ISCHANGED(Source_Capture__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Consent evidence cannot be changed after creation. Withdraw this consent and capture a new one.
